books.title: Open Data Structures (Java edition)
books.license: "This code is released under a Creative Commons Attribution license" (CC BY 2.5 Canada; COPYING covers latex/ and java/ods/)
books.notes: Sparse clone: latex/ + java/ods/ only (c, cpp, python dirs omitted). The book's code listings are pulled in from java/ods by the snarf-*.pl preprocessing scripts; the .tex itself has the prose, theorems and proofs (amortised analysis, hashing, trees, heaps, graphs).

books.title: Euclidean plane and its relatives: a minimalist introduction
books.license: "This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License." (CC BY-SA 4.0)
books.notes: Birkhoff-axiom approach: axioms, congruence, parallel lines, inversion, Poincare/Klein models, projective plane, sphere. Main file all-lectures.tex. Same author/style as n11 and n14.

books.title: Numerical Analysis (lecture notes, University of Ottawa)
books.license: "This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)"
books.notes: Root finding, interpolation, approximation of functions, numerical differentiation/integration, eigenvalues, IVPs, BVPs, finite differences, a discrete dynamical systems chapter. Main file notes.tex. Upper-undergrad / beginning grad, theorem-proof style.

books.title: Partial Differential Equations (lecture notes, University of Ottawa)
books.license: "This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)"
books.notes: A full PDE text: classification, characteristics, shock waves, wave/heat/Laplace equations, potential theory, Cauchy problem, distributions, Sobolev spaces, elliptic theory. Main file notes.tex. Note: on the Windows filesystem git reported case-colliding figure files potential/dbl_Layer*.pdf_t vs dbl_layer*.pdf_t; only one of each pair is checked out (figure overlays only).

books.title: Seven Sketches in Compositionality: An Invitation to Applied Category Theory
books.license: CC BY 4.0 (arXiv licence field: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
books.notes: arXiv source tarball (source.tar.gz kept) extracted; main 7Sketches.tex, chapters C1-C7 plus solutions C8a/C8b. Local PDF b230 also exists.

books.title: Basic Category Theory
books.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (arXiv licence field: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/)
books.notes: arXiv source extracted; main BasicCategoryTheory.tex (categories, adjoints, representables, limits, adjoints+limits). Best first category theory book. Local PDF b134 also exists.

books.title: Competitive Programmer's Handbook
books.license: "The license of the book is Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0."
books.notes: 30 chapters (sorting, DP, graphs, flows, trees, number theory, geometry, string algorithms). Lighter on formal proofs than Erickson/ODS; secondary algorithms source.

books.title: Stochastic Processes and Diffusion Equations (lecture notes)
books.license: CC BY 4.0 (arXiv licence field: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
books.notes: Short (single 45 KB mainred.tex, ~20 theorem/definition blocks): Brownian motion, heat equation, Ito calculus, Fokker-Planck. Only open-licence LaTeX found for stochastic processes; small.

books.title: A Computational Introduction to Number Theory and Algebra (2nd ed.)
books.license: "a Creative Commons license (Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs 3.0)" (CC BY-NC-ND 3.0, stated in the PDF front matter)
books.notes: 598 pp, author-hosted. ND clause: fine for reading/extraction, not for redistributing modified text.

books.title: An Introductory Course in Elementary Number Theory
books.license: CC BY 3.0 (Saylor Foundation release; LibreTexts copy also CC BY)
books.notes: 171 pp; congruences, multiplicative functions, primitive roots, quadratic residues, continued fractions, intro analytic NT. PDF has no licence line itself; licence from the Saylor announcement.

books.title: Numerical Methods (lecture notes)
books.license: "This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Hong Kong License." (CC BY 3.0 HK)
books.notes: 60 pp, short introductory notes; light on proofs.

books.title: Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems
books.license: free to read, not open ("Author's preliminary version made available with permission of the publisher, the American Mathematical Society"; may not be reposted)
books.notes: 364 pp. AMS GSM 140. Part II covers dynamical systems: stability, Poincare-Bendixson, attractors, chaos (Smale horseshoe, Melnikov), discrete dynamics.

books.title: Invitation to Dynamical Systems
books.license: free to read, not open (author-posted "postcardware" download; Dover holds the paperback; no open licence)
books.notes: 289 pp; continuous and discrete dynamics, chaos, fractals. Solutions manual also in the repo (inv-dyn-sys-solns.pdf, not downloaded).

books.title: Information Theory: From Coding to Learning
books.license: free to read, not open (author-hosted draft of the Cambridge UP book; "This publication is in copyright")
books.notes: 730 pp; rigorous theorem-proof style (entropy, divergence, f-divergences, lossless/lossy compression, channel coding, statistical lower bounds).

books.title: A First Course in Linear Optimization (4th ed., v4.07)
books.license: "This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License (CC BY 3.0)"
books.notes: 332 pp; LP duality, simplex, sensitivity, integer programming. Repo has PDFs only (v4.08 only as .7z, not unpacked); the PDF says 'the LaTeX source might be available' - ask the author (jon77lee@gmail.com) for the .tex.

books.title: Linear Programming: A Concise Introduction
books.license: free to read, not open (author-hosted electronic text, no licence stated)
books.notes: 66 pp (26 MB, scanned-quality figures); duality, simplex, matrix games.

books.title: Lectures on the Fourier Transform and its Applications (EE261 notes)
books.license: free to read, not open (Stanford Engineering Everywhere course material; SEE materials are generally CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 but the PDF states no licence)
books.notes: 428 pp; Fourier series, Fourier transform, distributions, sampling, DFT/FFT, Radon. Published later by AMS (2019).

books.title: An Introduction to Fourier and Complex Analysis with Applications to the Spectral Analysis of Signals
books.license: "licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial-Share Alike 3.0 United States License" (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US)

books.license: free to read, not open (PDF states only "Copyright 2015 by Russell L. Herman"; LibreTexts mirrors his books under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, unverified for this one)

books.title: Notes on Partial Differential Equations
books.license: free to read, not open (author-hosted UC Davis course notes, no licence stated)

books.title: Markov Chains and Mixing Times (2nd ed.)
books.authors: David A. Levin, Yuval Peres, Elizabeth L. Wilmer
books.license: free to read, not open (author-hosted with AMS permission)

books.title: Theory of Statistics
books.license: free to read, not open (author-hosted evolving notes, no licence stated)
books.notes: 925 pp; sufficiency, exponential families, UMVUE, MLE theory, Neyman-Pearson/UMP tests, asymptotics, Bayesian and decision theory. The best free match for the math-stats gap.

books.title: Probability and Statistics: The Science of Uncertainty (2nd ed.)

books.license: free to read, not open (author-hosted by Rosenthal at U. Toronto; published by W. H. Freeman)
books.notes: 774 pp; likelihood inference, MLE, hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference, plus Markov chains and martingales chapters.
